_A_INPUT_NUMBER_RANGE_COMPONENT_DESCRIPT: The AInputNumberRange component consists of two number fields "from" and "to". The model is an object with the keys min and max.
_A_INPUT_NUMBER_RANGE_GROUP_TYPE_INTEGER: type="integerRange" allows only integers in both fields.
_A_INPUT_NUMBER_RANGE_GROUP_PLACEHOLDER_: placeholder-min and placeholder-max set the placeholder of each field.
